statement: The fast pulse at eps = 1/10 has left endpoint c_1 = 1.1027477097341592491478677, the truncated midpoint of the c1 certificate, and speed in (c_1, c_1 + 10^-25). This file is the endpoint, not the whole existence chain.
The printed stability class has width 10^-58 inside the fast-pulse interval. winding_bottom.json is the bottom piece of that winding, not the whole spectral proof. Nonlinear stability is not proved.
A slow pulse at eps = 1/10 and at eps = 3/20, each in an open speed bracket of width 10^-25. These files are the c1 endpoints, not the whole existence chains.

A pulse at gain 12 with speed in an open bracket of width 10^-25 about the stored c1 endpoint. The file is that endpoint, not the whole existence chain. Three rest-eigenvalue radii are larger than half a unit in the last printed place.
Faye's model at eps = 1/100, 1/50 and 1/20, each an open bracket between the exact ends in config.py. The forty-digit prints round the last digit except at 1/20, which forces all 28 digits.
Enculescu, Physica D 196 (2004), was not obtained.
Sandstede (2007) is known from its abstract only.
